title: idpf-issue-reviewer result
description: The JSON result one idpf-issue-reviewer instance returns for the one issue it reviewed (#3499, PRD #3493). The parent validates it with .claude/scripts/shared/lib/subagent-result.js before the issue enters the review roster; a result failing validation, an empty reply or an errored Agent call is that instance's error, never a guessed recommendation. Role contract: Reference/Agent-Architecture.md. An outcome of "error" (#3806) is the reviewer reporting its own failure (a step that could not run, a gh secondary rate limit) with the message in error: it requires only issue, outcome and error, and the parent reports it under the issue with no verdict event. A result whose outcome is "reviewed" or absent (the form /work's reviewer results take) keeps the five original fields required.

outcome.description: reviewed — the review ran to finalize; error — it did not, and error says why. Absent reads as reviewed, so /work's reviewer results validate unchanged.

recommendation.description: The /review-issue Step 2d recommendation, one of its four values.

labelAssigned.description: review-finalize.js labelAssigned, verbatim. null when the label swap failed; the parent's Step 3b verdict event emits nothing for it.

reviewNumber.description: The **Reviews:** N value finalize wrote for this review.

filesToModifyWritten.description: Whether the 2a-ii (b) Files-to-modify write ran before finalize (#2891). false for an epic, which 2a-ii does not cover. The roster shows false.

commentUrl.description: The URL of the review comment finalize posted, when known.

priorArtWritten.description: Whether the 2a-iv **Prior Art:** write ran before finalize. The roster shows false, so a skipped write is visible.

error.description: Required when outcome is error: the failure message, verbatim — a gh message stays as gh printed it.
